review_findings: The new owner is only the durable conversational session order; it delegates semantic selection, execution, evidence validation, write permission, and completion to existing authorities.
One session binds one exact registration, user request, resolved Workflow, stable TaskRun, and current runtime state.
The orchestrator accepts injected Providers/checkpointer/Guard and therefore does not create target-specific fallback authority.
Next actions are projections of canonical runtime states, not new Workflow outcomes.
No automatic confirmation, completion, merge, or customer runtime dependency is introduced.

skill_rule_mappings.assessment: the orchestrator creates/reopens exactly one TaskRun and every runtime transition is checkpointed through StarterWorkflowRuntime
WAITING_HOST is projected as an action; only DurableHostSkillBridge.submit_result plus runtime resume can advance it
exact mutation confirmation is required, then existing WriteAuthorityGuard remains independently required during dispatch
all session artifacts are control-plane files under .harness and product code imports none of the new module
